# M18-S1 (#4) side-stack arena growth across parked goroutines (SPEC Sec 8.3,
# T-301.1, IMPLEMENTATION.md M18-S1 AR4). A goroutine parked with empty
# arena regions must return its leased chunk, including empty chunks behind
# a live chunk, while retaining every live chunk and preserving addresses.
# With no live chunks it must retain no arena capacity. Values alone pass
# even when empty chunks leak, and Sys still counts P-cached chunks, so a
# run fixture cannot prove release. This script runs the leased-count waves
# (well under the 8128 race-detector limit) that fail on count, not values.
# The duplicate -race leg exists because SPEC.md:2096 requires every runtime
# attack test to run under the race detector.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOEXPERIMENT=logosarena
go test -count=1 -run 'TestLogosArenaParkReturnsChunk|TestLogosArenaParkKeepsLiveChunk|TestLogosArenaMarkSurvivesPark|TestLogosArenaParkReleasesEmptyHeadOverLiveTail|TestLogosArenaParkReleasesEmptyChunksBehindLiveHead' runtime
go test -race -count=1 -run 'TestLogosArenaParkReturnsChunk|TestLogosArenaParkKeepsLiveChunk|TestLogosArenaMarkSurvivesPark|TestLogosArenaParkReleasesEmptyHeadOverLiveTail|TestLogosArenaParkReleasesEmptyChunksBehindLiveHead' runtime

-- go.mod --
module example.com/redteam4

go 1.27
